name: Windows
description: Windows inside a Docker container, installed for you

paths.name: Storage
paths.description: The Windows disk, the downloaded installer and icestore-password.txt. Needs at least 32 GB free, more for a bigger DISK_SIZE.

paths.name: Shared
paths.description: A folder shared with Windows. It shows as Shared on the desktop and as drive Z.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Web viewer (the Windows screen in your browser), published on host as 6187

ports.name: Port 3389
ports.description: Remote Desktop (RDP), TCP and UDP, published on host as 6188

ports.name: Port 3389
ports.description: Remote Desktop (RDP), TCP and UDP, published on host as 6188

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: VERSION
variables.description: Which Windows to download and install. 11 is Windows 11 Pro. Others: 11l (11 LTSC), 10 (10 Pro), 10l (10 LTSC), 2025 or 2022 (Server), tiny11, xp, 7u. The full list is on the Windows page in IceStore. Pick it before the first start.

variables.name: RAM_SIZE
variables.description: Memory for Windows, like 4G or 8G. Keep it below the memory your MOS box has free, and below 16G.

variables.name: CPU_CORES
variables.description: How many processor cores Windows may use, like 2 or 4.

variables.name: DISK_SIZE
variables.description: The size of the Windows disk, like 64G or 128G. You can make it bigger later; then extend the C drive in Windows Disk Management.

variables.name: USERNAME
variables.description: The Windows user made when Windows installs. Pick it before the first start.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.description: The password of that user, used when Windows installs. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one, shown in the app log in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Change it later inside Windows.
